identity.tagline: A simple way to live stream your wedding and keep your family members & loved ones connected
identity.team_size_hint: multi-person team (camera operator, live stream director, professional staff referenced)

location.service_area_text: Based in Orlando FL but services nationwide

services.camera_count_options: 1 angle (Professional) to 3 angles (Deluxe), additional angles available in Custom tier
services.guest_interaction_features: "Virtual Wedding Toast" add-on lets a remote guest video-call in and interact live with the couple while other virtual/in-person guests watch
equipment_highlights: cameras ranging from GoPros to high-end cinema cameras (e.g. RED, Blackmagic)

pricing.travel_fee_notes: Pricing is dependent on venue internet; if connectivity is limited, internet cost is added to package price based on broadcast length
pricing.pricing_notes: $75 non-refundable retainer + signed contract required to book; balance due 5 days before the wedding

content.description_seo: Live Hub Events is an Orlando, Florida-based live streaming company that covers weddings nationwide. The team provides on-site camera operators, wireless audio, and a custom private viewing page so remote guests can watch the ceremony in real time. Packages range from a single-camera stream with a private YouTube link to a three-camera Deluxe package with a dedicated stream director and an edited highlight video, and the company can add reception coverage, backup internet, and multi-platform streaming for larger guest counts. A notable extra is an optional "virtual wedding toast," letting one remote guest join a live video call that both in-person and streaming guests can see.
content.one_line_summary: Orlando-based, nationwide-traveling wedding livestream company offering 1-3 camera packages, a private viewing page, and an optional virtual guest video-call toast.

faq_items.q: Do the cameras get in the way?
faq_items.a_summary: No — zoom lenses let cameras be placed at the back/sides of the room, coordinated with the couple's photographer/videographer.

faq_items.q: Is there a person at each camera?
faq_items.a_summary: No, tripods with multiple angles are used; setup is battery powered and portable.

faq_items.q: Can I rent the equipment and stream it myself?
faq_items.a_summary: No, it's a turnkey service — an operator, camera, and audio gear are included.

faq_items.q: Do I need internet at my venue?
faq_items.a_summary: Not required; they can bring alternative connectivity, though cost varies with required stream quality.

faq_items.q: How many people can watch simultaneously?
faq_items.a_summary: Up to 200 people included; more possible via Facebook/YouTube Live.
